text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: quantile score over the five decision substations (smaller is better); the dashed line is A1, the same model without a filter. Bottom: mean absolute size of A3's correction, split into the persistent level and the transient. Weather is an estimate of past weather.'
text.tspan: Top: quantile score over the five decision substations (smaller is better); the dashed line is
A1, the same model without a filter. Bottom: mean absolute size of A3's correction, split into
the persistent level and the transient. Weather is an estimate of past weather.
